connect.subtitle: Remote control for your agent sessions

picker.title: Sessions
picker.empty: No sessions yet. Open your editor with the bridge running.
picker.hubOffline: Hub offline — it starts together with your editor. Waiting…

chat.noSession: No session selected — open the menu to pick one
chat.imageTooLarge: GIF/SVG images must be under 5 MB
chat.closeSessionHint: Removes it from this list. A conversation still open in the editor reappears on its next use.
chat.shutdownInstanceHint: Closes the terminal window running this session (or its background bridge). History stays; re-opening a session starts a new window.
chat.renameSessionHint: The title shows here, in the editor, and in the ZCode app.
chat.diffTruncated: Large diff — showing the first 20k characters

zconfig.title: ZCode configuration
zconfig.scope: Applies to the machine this app is connected to
zconfig.unsupported: This hub is too old for the configuration API
zconfig.unsupportedHint: Update zcode-acp-server to 0.47.0 or newer on this machine
zconfig.restartPending: Some changes only take effect after the backend restarts.
zconfig.restartWarning: Restarting cancels any turn still running on that bridge.
zconfig.restartNoInstance: Open a session first — the restart has to name the bridge it belongs to.
zconfig.resetPickProvider: Pick which plan's cards to show
zconfig.resetTeamBlocked: Team plans can only be reset from the ZCode desktop app
zconfig.resetUnavailable: Card status unavailable — the credential store couldn't be read
zconfig.resetConfirm: Spend a {{title}} card expiring {{expires}}? This cannot be undone.
zconfig.resetBelowThreshold: Below {{pct}}% usage, spending a card asks for an extra confirmation
zconfig.resetBelowWarn: Usage hasn't reached {{pct}}% yet — spend a reset card anyway?
zconfig.modelsHint: Selectable models and their context windows
zconfig.modelKeepBlank: Optional — blank keeps the current value
zconfig.modelLevelsHint: Pick from the levels this machine's models already use — none selected keeps the current ones
zconfig.modelLevelsNone: No reasoning levels configured on this machine
zconfig.skillsHint: Discovered skills and their enabled state
zconfig.hooksHint: The commands that run on each event
zconfig.hooksReadOnly: Entries can be edited, not added or removed
zconfig.agentsHint: Tap a subagent to configure it
zconfig.agentsCreateHint: A new subagent starts with a template prompt — refine the markdown under ~/.zcode/agents on the desktop
zconfig.agentInheritHint: Blank = inherit; clearing a set value restores inheritance
zconfig.agentThoughtNone: This model has no reasoning levels
zconfig.agentOverrideNone: No override — follows the session model
zconfig.usageHint: Tokens this machine spent, per model
zconfig.usageNoData: No usage recorded on this machine
zconfig.backupsHint: Restore an earlier version of a config file
zconfig.backupsScope: Each file is restored on its own
zconfig.appUpdateHint: Check for and install a newer ZCode build
zconfig.updateRestartApp: Quit and reopen ZCode to use it
zconfig.updateNeedsUser: The install location refused the swap
zconfig.updateNeedsUserHint: The verified build is at the path above — move it into place yourself
zconfig.updateConfirm: Install {{version}} now? The download runs in the background.

permission.title: Permission requested
permission.hint: The first answer across all clients wins

notice.unsupported: This interaction must be answered in your editor
notice.instanceGone: Instance went away — pick another one
notice.noSession: Pick a session first (from the menu)
notice.sessionRunning: Session is running — cancel the turn first
notice.projectUnknown: Unknown project — refresh the list and pick again
notice.configNeedsRestart: Saved — restart the backend to apply it
notice.configResetDenied: Not right now — the backend declined a reset
notice.configResetSpent: Card spent — the window is reset
notice.configResetStale: That reset attempt expired — the card list was refreshed, try again
notice.configRestartFailed: The old backend did not stop — your changes are saved but not applied yet, try again

projectDialog.creatingHint: A terminal window opens on the desktop machine — allow ~20s

historyDialog.title: Session history
historyDialog.hint: Pick a project to browse its past sessions
historyDialog.listHint: Tap a session to resume it — history replays first
historyDialog.listEmpty: No sessions recorded for this project yet
historyDialog.waking: Waking the project's bridge — first load can take ~12s
